newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway index up with Hydro, Nycomed, DnB.
newsitem.headline: Norway index up with Hydro, Nycomed, DnB.

text.p: Industrial conglomerate Norsk Hydro, pharmaceutical group Nycomed and Den norske Bank (DnB) helped lift Norwegian shares on Friday.
The Total share index rose 0.68 percent to 873.81 points.

Turnover was a moderate 578 million crowns, including 102 million crowns in Norsk Hydro. The company, which has a 20-percent weighting on the TOTX, closed 0.5 percent higher at 295.50 crowns. Nycomed continued to firm the day after the company announced a series of measures to cut costs and restructure operations. Nycomed's A share closed 1.69 percent higher at 90.50 crowns in 51 million crowns of trade.
DnB, which reported rising net profits on Thursday, also continued to appreciate, jumping 3.30 percent to 21.90 crowns with 46 million crowns worth of shares changing hands.

Bergesen A and B shares finished 3.23 percent and 3.26 percent higher respectively at 144 and 142.50 crowns after the company said that it planned to buy three supertankers from Petroleum Shipping Ltd., a subsidiary of the Exxon Corporation, for $35 million.
